Class AvogadroClientApi

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.client.AvogadroClientApi
public final class AvogadroClientApi extends Object
Client-only tools for drawing molecules, looking up client definitions, and exporting media.

Call drawing methods from the render thread, such as inside a screen's drawing method. Do not load this class from code that also runs on a dedicated server.

    • render

      public static void render(MoleculeStructure structure, int x, int y, int width, int height, MoleculeRenderOptions options, double elapsedSeconds)
      Renders a molecule structure with explicit dimensions, options, and reproducible timing.

      Call this from the render thread. Pass the number of seconds since your animation started; using the same time value draws the same rotation.

      Parameters:
      structure - the molecule structure to render
      x - the x-coordinate on the screen
      y - the y-coordinate on the screen
      width - the render width
      height - the render height
      options - the rendering options to apply
      elapsedSeconds - seconds since your animation started

    • elementColors

      public static ElementPalette.Snapshot elementColors()
      Returns effective opaque ARGB sphere/cube colors after pack, programmatic, and local overrides. Use the common ElementColors API to register RGB layers. Retain this immutable snapshot for an operation that must not change color halfway through.
      Returns:
      the current client palette; unchanged reads allocate nothing

    • reloadElementColors

      public static CompletableFuture<ElementPalette.Snapshot> reloadElementColors()
      Reloads only element-color resources and the local partial JSON, without a full F3+T reload. Work is scheduled on the Minecraft client thread; callers may invoke this method from any thread in the client process. Never block that thread waiting for the returned future. Failed parsing completes exceptionally and leaves the last valid palette active. Programmatic owner layers remain installed, local user choices keep precedence, and existing exports remain unchanged.
      Returns:
      future containing the resulting immutable effective palette, or the reload exception
